capabilities: Create/read/extract genuine bounded AES256 ZIP files with authenticated entry validation
Read a supported encrypted PDF with an explicitly supplied password without publishing plaintext
Fill supported Word templates from an explicit exact field mapping into a new DOCX
Remove explicitly selected complete supported PDF text operands from a fresh derived PDF
reviewed_corrections: All local and central AES indicators select strict authentication; contradictory encryption metadata refuses
Malformed archive options hide the full preview so a repeated password cannot escape through another argument
Legacy PDF password encoding and running deadline errors are handled correctly
Split or escaped Word placeholders in unsupported locations refuse rather than remaining silently unresolved
PDF redaction refuses when remaining glyphs could reconstruct a removed target in any order
limits: Encrypted ZIP supports a bounded WinZip AE1/AE2 AES256 stored/deflate subset; names remain visible; encrypted edit/conversion refuses
Protected PDF reading supports a bounded inert extraction-permitted profile; no PDF password writing or form access
Word fill supports inert DOCX/DOTX body/table same-style placeholders; missing/extra fields and unsupported formatting or locations refuse
PDF redaction supports unique complete ASCII Tj operands in a restricted inert profile and conservatively refuses possible glyph reconstruction; it is not general layout-aware redaction
